address_street.value: 13101 Leopard Street at the O.N. Stevens Water Treatment Plant

services.value: Supports water quality operations for Corpus Christi Water and offers services to external public water systems, municipalities, industrial facilities, consulting or engineering firms, and other commercial or public organizations wanting to monitor water quality and meet regulatory requirements. The laboratory also tests water samples for the public and offers free total coliform sample processing for public water systems attempting to lift boil water notices.
